verdict.rationale: cubic's AI wiki indexes the codebase automatically and produces searchable wikis with source links and architecture diagrams. It also exports them as markdown into the repo and keeps them current through a rolling PR, which serves the team as a shared reference built from repos. The evidence does not show ingesting separate docs, or an explicit shared-workspace construct the lead creates. The `cubic.yaml` "source of truth" applies only to review configuration, so it is adjacent and not credited here. Missing for 10: building the workspace from non-code docs, an explicit shared team workspace or collaboration model, multi-repo aggregation into one knowledge base, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.
cubic exports the wiki as markdown files into a directory in your repo (default `.cubic/wiki`) and keeps them current through a rolling pull request.
